title: Switch from V8 to QuickJSR
description:
Is it possible to switch from `V8` to `QuickJSR`? https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/QuickJSR/index.html
`V8` is a very heavy dependency, also broken on some non-mainstream platforms.
Depending on it creates problems further down with `juicyjuice` dependents, ex.: https://github.com/rstudio/gt/issues/1179

title: Make package juicier overall
description: The package has one function with no options. Maybe add some options? The `juice` library has them, this does not.  *That’s* the underlying issue.
